title: 第3章 天选奶娘第4章 她一个没奶的拿什么来喂
slug: 未婚当奶娘可她婴语满级啊
content_zh:
苏念禾环顾四周看其他人并无异样，确认了一下ai的声音只有自己可以听到，压制着心中的喜悦，立马小声说道。
“绑定绑定，速速绑定。”
生怕错失良机似的。
随后在她的脑海中便浮现出一个科技感满满的霓虹色虚拟界面。
几个带着烟花特效的大字赫然出现在眼前：恭喜宿主绑定成功！
万物购商城竭诚为你服务！
宿主担任奶娘期间，可随时随地下单商城物品，秒拍秒付秒送达。
苏念禾最关心的环节来了，还不知道商城的物价如何？
毕竟她现在身无分文，兜比脸干净。
随后她在虚拟界面的左侧方找到一行小字：
商城物品需用积分兑换，绝对物超所值，最终解释权归商城所有。
苏念禾继续向下看，兑换标准为：1积分＝1铜板。
但她还没有看到商品标价，还无法评判这个兑换标准，是低是高。
她赶紧用意念打开主界面，日用、美服、美妆、数码、居家、母婴、运动、健康医疗、出行等应有尽有。
当她的目光扫过军工板块时，身子为之一震，激动之心无以言表。
苏念禾不由得感慨：真不愧是万物购，万物皆有！
物品种类也太齐全了！
就连现实中的特殊种类也囊括其内！
安全感爆棚！
那她需要的配方奶和奶瓶就应该在母婴区域了。

她正准备进入母婴词条搜索，突然屏幕一亮，闪现出来了一个九头身如精灵一般的ai推荐官。
【主人，我是商城ai推荐官万万。
可以帮助你智能搜索，确保当下物品最符合实际应用，省去比价测评环节，提高你的购物体验……】
苏念禾用手捂住自己的衣兜，下意识反应，这……很贵吧？
甭想从我兜里多要一个子儿……
ai万万仿佛看穿了她的心思，朝她放了一个电眼。
【主人，无须担心，万万是商城特意为你匹配的推荐官，服务过程全程免费。】
苏念禾秒变脸，不值钱地笑着：“那就好，那就好。
辛苦万万帮我搜索一下婴儿配方奶粉，还有奶瓶……”
【收到主人，请稍等，万万快马加鞭为你搜索。】
几秒后，虚拟屏幕上就迸发出炫彩的灯光，出现了一小罐配方奶粉和s号奶嘴瓶。
【折扣专享区，套装组合，只需50个积分，这是当前搜索到性价比最高的组合，请问主人是否下单？】
50个积分就是50个铜板。
相对比线是动辄上百块的奶瓶，几百块的奶粉，这价格嘛，倒也不算太贵。
可惜，苏念禾手里一个铜板也没有。
她弱弱地问：“那个，有没有新手福利？或者新手大礼包？”
【主人可说出心仪价格，万万这就带着你的诚意去砍价。】
“有没有可能……送一单？”
ai万万眨了眨眼。
【主人是想白嫖？万万已经明确你的指令，请稍等片刻……】

紧接着，苏念禾就看到虚拟屏上一阵火花带闪电，战损万万出现。
苏念禾心惊：这是去砍价了，还是去打架了？
万万不会有事儿吧？
content_en:
Su Nianhe looked around and saw that there was nothing strange about the others. He confirmed that only he could hear the AI's voice. He suppressed the joy in his heart and whispered immediately.
"Bind, bind, bind quickly."
As if afraid of missing a good opportunity.
Then a neon-colored virtual interface full of technology appeared in her mind.
Several large characters with fireworks special effects suddenly appeared in front of you: Congratulations on the successful binding of the host!
Wagongou Mall is here to serve you wholeheartedly!
While the host is serving as a nanny, she can place orders for items in the mall anytime and anywhere, and they will be delivered in seconds.
Now comes the part that Su Nianhe is most concerned about. I still don’t know what the prices are in the mall?
After all, she is now penniless and has a clean face.
Then she found a line of small words on the left side of the virtual interface:
The items in the mall need to be redeemed with points, which are absolutely worth the money. The final right of interpretation belongs to the mall.
Su Nianhe continued to look down, and the redemption standard was: 1 point = 1 copper plate.
But she hasn't seen the price of the product yet, so she can't judge whether the exchange standard is low or high.
She quickly used her mind to open the main interface, which contained everything from daily necessities, clothing, cosmetics, digital, home, mother and baby, sports, health and medical, travel, etc.
When her eyes swept over the military industry section, her body was shaken, and her excitement was beyond words.
Su Nianhe couldn't help but sigh: It's truly a shop for everything, everything is available!
The variety of items is also too complete!
Even special species in reality are included!
The sense of security is overwhelming!
Then the formula milk and bottles she needs should be in the maternal and infant area.
She was about to enter the maternal and infant term search when suddenly the screen lit up and an AI recommendation officer with nine heads and an elf-like body appeared.
[Master, I am Wanwan, the AI ​​recommendation officer of the mall.
It can help you search intelligently, ensure that the current items are most suitable for practical applications, save the price comparison and evaluation process, and improve your shopping experience...]
Su Nianhe covered his pockets with his hands and subconsciously reacted, this... is expensive, right?
Don't even think about asking for an extra penny from my pocket...
Ai Wanwan seemed to have read through her thoughts and shot her an electric eye.
[Master, there is no need to worry, it is definitely the recommendation officer specially matched by the mall for you, and the service process is free of charge. 】
Su Nianhe's face changed instantly and he smiled worthlessly: "That's good, that's good.
Please help me search for baby formula and milk bottles..."
[Received from the owner, please wait a moment, Wanwan will work hard to search for you. 】
A few seconds later, colorful lights burst out on the virtual screen, and a small can of formula milk powder and a size S pacifier bottle appeared.
[Exclusive discount area, set combination, only 50 points are required. This is the most cost-effective combination currently found. Would you like to place an order? 】
50 points equals 50 copper plates.
The comparison line is that milk bottles cost hundreds of yuan, and milk powder costs several hundred yuan. These prices are not too expensive.
Unfortunately, Su Nianhe didn't have a single coin in his hand.
She asked weakly: "Well, are there any benefits for newbies? Or a gift package for newbies?"
[The owner can tell you the price you want, and you can bargain with your sincerity. 】
"Is it possible... to send an order?"
AI Wanwan blinked.
[Does the master want to have sex for free? Wanwan has confirmed your instructions, please wait a moment...]
Immediately afterwards, Su Nianhe saw a burst of sparks and lightning on the virtual screen, and tens of thousands of battle losses appeared.
Su Nianhe was shocked: Are you going to bargain or fight?
Nothing will happen, right?
